edges.reason: Spruce boat requires 5 spruce planks crafted from spruce logs obtained by chopping spruce trees
Stone shovel requires 2 sticks which are crafted from planks derived from chopped logs
Dark oak stairs are mined fastest with an axe; wooden axe requires planks and sticks from chopped logs
Mining lapis ore requires a stone pickaxe which needs sticks from planks from chopped logs
Crafting red wool requires access to crafting table; planks from logs needed for sticks and table interaction
Blue banner is across a deep lake (4 blocks deep); spruce boat required for safe water traversal
Light gray stained glass building is beyond the blue banner structure; banner serves as navigation waypoint
Black concrete powder is inside a fully enclosed room; mining dark oak stairs wall is the only entry point
Pink concrete is adjacent to black concrete powder inside the same sealed storage room
Shepherd villager merchant is inside the concrete storage room; must enter room to access trade interface
Stone shovel crafting proves stick/tool knowledge needed; bed is in same workshop area accessed during crafting

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because chopping spruce trees (at ~3,0,2 / ~5,0,3 / ~7,0,2) produces spruce_log items that end up in the player's inventory. This is the standard check for tree-chopping tasks.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a spruce boat (5 spruce planks in U-shape at crafting table) results in the boat item appearing in the player's inventory. Not in starting inventory so presence confirms crafting.
Uses inventory_has because crafting a stone shovel (1 cobblestone + 2 sticks at crafting table) results in the item appearing in inventory. Not in starting inventory so presence confirms crafting.
Uses inventory_has because mining lapis ore with a stone pickaxe drops lapis_lazuli items (4-9 per block) into the player's inventory. The drop is lapis_lazuli, not the ore block itself.
Uses inventory_has because mining a black bed (at ~-4,0,5) drops the bed as an item into inventory. Beds break instantly by hand and always drop themselves.
Uses inventory_has because mining dark oak stairs (sealed room west wall at x=10, z=1-3, y=0-1) drops the stairs block as an item into inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Blue banner is at spawn-relative (3,2,17) on structure across the 4-block-deep lake. Max distance 4 blocks ensures player physically crossed the lake and reached the far shore. Facing tolerance 60 degrees confirms visual observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Light gray stained glass is at spawn-relative (3,1,23) in building beyond the banner. Max distance 4 blocks ensures player navigated past banner structure to second building.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Black concrete powder is at spawn-relative (11,0,1) inside the fully sealed concrete room. Max distance 3 blocks ensures player is physically inside the room (only accessible after mining dark oak stairs wall).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. Pink concrete is at spawn-relative (13,0,2) inside the sealed concrete room, adjacent to black concrete powder. Max distance 3 blocks ensures player is inside the room.

Uses inventory_has because crafting red wool (1 white_wool + 1 red_dye, shapeless recipe at crafting table) results in red_wool appearing in inventory. Materials in workshop chest. Not in starting inventory so presence confirms crafting.

Uses inventory_has because selling black dye to the shepherd villager (at ~12,0,4 inside concrete room) yields emeralds via trade (1 black_dye → 1 emerald). No other emerald source exists in the scene, so emerald presence uniquely confirms a successful trade.

scene_description: A compact lakeside area designed to enforce all dependency chains through spatial constraints. Player spawns near spruce trees with a workshop area. A 4-block-deep lake requires a boat to cross safely. Across the lake are structures with a blue banner and light gray stained glass windows. A fully enclosed concrete storage room (only accessible by mining dark oak stairs wall) contains black concrete powder, pink concrete, and a shepherd villager merchant. The workshop provides crafting materials but NO pre-provided stone pickaxe — player must craft one from cobblestone and sticks obtained from chopping trees.
task_text: Starting at the lakeside workshop, chop spruce trees to gather wood. Use the crafting table to craft a spruce boat, stone shovel, and stone pickaxe. Cross the deep lake by boat to find the blue banner, then locate light gray stained glass in the building beyond. Mine the dark oak stairs blocking the sealed concrete storage room to enter and find black concrete powder and pink concrete inside. Sell black dye to the shepherd villager inside that room. Craft red wool at the workshop using materials from the chest. Mine the black bed near the workshop and mine lapis ore in the mining pit.
design_notes: FINAL LAYOUT (v2): Player spawns at origin. Three spruce trees at (~3,0,2), (~5,0,3), (~7,0,2) provide 10+ logs. Workshop at (~-2,0,1-3) has crafting table, furnace, and materials chest (16 cobblestone, 3 white_wool, 2 red_dye, 14 black_dye, 4 string). Black bed at (~-4,0,5). Mining pit at (~-7 to -5, -2 to -3, -2) with lapis ore exposed at y=-2/-3 via stone stairs descent. Deep lake (4 blocks: y=-4 to y=-1) spans z=8-15. Banner structure at z=17-18 with blue banner at (3,2,17). Glass building at z=20-23 with light_gray_stained_glass on south wall. Sealed concrete room: oak_planks shell (10,-1,-1 to 14,3,5), interior air (11,0,0 to 13,2,4), ONLY entry via dark_oak_stairs at x=10 z=1-3. Contains black_concrete_powder, pink_concrete, and shepherd villager. Fixed from v1: removed duplicate banner, single placement at (3,2,17).
